en: Vintage postcard with a monochrome panoramic view of a city nestled among hills. A hilltop citadel/fortified complex appears on the right, with dense rooftops and a large open square in the center. The caption on the image reads "Brașov — Kronstadt." The reverse side is printed "România — Cartă Postală" with address lines and a small printed letter "E"; there is also a red hand-stamped number "1237."
